purpose: Original warm-grey clay plaster albedo texture for StoryOS Library walls

reference.role: Viewed only for broad wall-material character; not supplied as an edit target

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: seamless square game material ALBEDO / BASE COLOR texture, minimum 1024 by 1024 pixels.
Primary request: One original tileable warm-grey clay plaster wall texture for a mature sculptural stop-motion fairy-tale interior.
Style: softly hand-sculpted plaster, with subtle broad irregular trowel marks and a few very large soft variations in colour. Restrained handcrafted sophistication, tactile matte mineral surface. Calm, sparse surface, with generous quiet areas.
Color: light warm grey beige, close to neutral and desaturated, suitable for tinting at runtime. Low contrast. Uniform average exposure across the tile.
Composition: pure material texture covering the entire square edge to edge, perfectly orthographic flat front-on scan, seamless repeat matching all four edges.
Critical constraints: ALBEDO ONLY, no baked lighting, no cast shadows, no highlights, no directional shading, no vignetting, no scene, no room, no objects, no perspective, no corners, no border, no text or symbols. No obvious cracks, no mottled mildew spots, no dense speckling, no paper fibres, no woodgrain or woodblock-print marks. Do not depict a finished lit wall; output only the flat colour texture surface.

inspection.visual: Low-contrast matte warm-grey/beige plaster with broad trowel traces; no objects, borders, symbols, paper fibre or woodgrain.
inspection.limitations: Minor relief-like tonal traces remain. Use as subdued base colour; actual tiled wall appearance should be checked in the scene.
